location_exception_reason: Eco portable cabins are manufactured prefabricated units sold nationwide; buyer decision is driven by material type (FRP/PUF), dimensions, and application, not origin location. No GI designation or regional origin significance.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer) are redundant in titles; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'Eco Portable Cabin Manufacturer' leaves the product meaning unchanged.
